titleEn: Inauguration Day speech at Capital One Arena
titleZh: 第一资本体育馆就职典礼日演讲
summaryEn: Elon Musk addresses the crowd at the Capital One Arena on Donald Trump's Inauguration Day: "this was no ordinary victory — this was a fork in the road of human civilization," thanking supporters for making it happen and looking ahead to safe cities, secure borders, sound money and sending humans to Mars.
summaryZh: 埃隆·马斯克在唐纳德·特朗普的就职典礼日向第一资本体育馆的人群发表讲话：“这不是一次普通的胜利——这是人类文明道路上的一个岔路口”，他感谢支持者促成这一切，并展望安全的城市、安全的边境、稳健的货币，以及把人类送上火星。

segments.textEn: This is what victory feels like. Yeah.
segments.textZh: 这就是胜利的感觉。是的。

segments.textEn: And this was no ordinary victory. This was a fork in the road of human civilization. Okay, this, this, you know, there, there are elections that, Elections that come and go. Some, some elections are, you know, important, some are not, but, but this one, this one, this one really matters. And I just want to say thank you for making it happen. Thank you.
segments.textZh: 而这不是一次普通的胜利。这是人类文明道路上的一个岔路口。好吧，这，这个，你知道，有，有些选举，选举来了又去。有些，有些选举，你知道，很重要，有些则不重要，但是，但是这一次，这一次，这一次真的很重要。我只想说，谢谢你们促成了这一切。谢谢你们。

segments.textEn: My heart goes out to you.
It is thanks to you that the future of civilization is assured.
segments.textZh: 正是因为你们，文明的未来才有了保障。

segments.textEn: Thanks to you, we're going to have safe cities finally. Safe cities, secure boats, sensible spending, basic stuff.
segments.textZh: 多亏了你们，我们终于会拥有安全的城市。安全的城市、安全的船只、合理的支出，都是些基本的事情。

segments.textEn: And we're going to take Doge to Mars.
segments.textZh: 而且我们要把 Doge 带上火星。

segments.textEn: I mean, can you imagine how awesome it will be to have American astronauts plant the flag on another planet for the first time?
segments.textZh: 我是说，你们能想象美国宇航员首次在另一颗行星上插上国旗会有多棒吗？

segments.textEn: How inspiring would that be? You know, there's always, there's always problems and problems in life. You know, this problem, solved that problem, solved that problem. But, you know, there need to be things that inspire you. There needs to be things that make you glad to wake up in the morning and say, I'm looking forward to the future.
segments.textZh: 那会多么鼓舞人心啊？你知道，生活中总是会有，总是会有问题和问题。你知道，这个问题，解决了那个问题，解决了那个问题。但是，你知道，需要有一些能激励你的事情。需要有一些事情，让你高兴地在早晨醒来并说，我期待着未来。

segments.textEn: And, and, and, and let me tell you, I'm gonna work my ass up for you guys.
segments.textZh: 还有、还有、还有、还有，让我告诉你们，我会为你们干到屁股朝上。

segments.textEn: And, yeah. But I'm super fired up for the future. It's going to be very exciting. As the President said, we're going to have a golden age. It's going to be fantastic.
segments.textZh: 还有，是的。但我对未来无比振奋。未来会非常令人兴奋。正如总统所说，我们将迎来一个黄金时代。那会非常棒。

segments.textEn: And one of the fundamental things that. One of the most American values that I love is optimism and this feeling like we're going to make the future good. We're going to make it good.
segments.textZh: 而其中一个根本性的事情是。一个我所热爱的、最具美国特色的价值观之一，就是乐观，以及这种我们要让未来变得美好的感觉。我们要让它变得美好。

segments.textEn: So, man, I can't wait. This is gonna be fantastic.
segments.textZh: 所以，天啊，我都等不及了。这会非常棒。

segments.textEn: So thanks. Thank you. Thank you again. And, yeah, I'm just so excited about the future. Thank you, guys. Thank you.
segments.textZh: 所以，谢谢。谢谢。再次感谢。而且，是的，我只是对未来感到无比兴奋。谢谢大家。谢谢。
